 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order
% 31.05.2023 Crl.M.A. 15444/2023 (Exemption)
1. Exemption is allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is disposed of.

1. This petition has been filed for seeking quashing of the FIR No.330/2020 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at PS GTB Enclave, Delhi, on the ground of a settlement between the parties dated 28.01.2021 arrived at with the facilitation of Delhi Mediation Centre, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi.

entities.text: Delhi Mediation Centre, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Petitioner Nos.1 - 5 and respondent No.2/complainant are present before the Court, duly identified by the counsels and the IO.

As per the settlement, a final balance amount of Rs.1,60,000/-
is being tendered to respondent No.2 vide a DD No.007433 dated 30.05.2023 for Rs.1,60,000/-
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 08/10/2023 at 08:12:35 drawn on HDFC Bank, Pandav Nagar, Delhi, which has been duly received by her and acknowledged.
The marriage of petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 has resulted in a divorce vide decree dated 02.04.2022.
No child was born out of the wedlock.
Respondent No.2 has no objection to the quashing of the FIR and her affidavit in this regard is also on record.

3. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State Sh. sentences.text: Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.330/2020 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at PS GTB Enclave, Delhi, and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.

Pending applications, if any, are disposed of as infructuous..
5.
Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J MAY 31, 2023/kct
